passages.title: 웨비나 발표 리허설 안내 메일
passages.passage:
From: Events Team
To: Webinar Presenters
Subject: Rehearsal Schedule — 'Pricing in Uncertain Markets'

Dear presenters,

Our public webinar on October 9 has 1,400 registrations, our largest audience this year. To make sure the session runs smoothly, we ask all four presenters to join a full rehearsal on October 6 at 3 p.m.

The rehearsal covers slide handovers between speakers, the audience poll timing, and the Q&A tool. Please use the same computer, camera, and network you will use on the day — half of last year's technical issues came from presenters switching equipment after rehearsal.

Slides are due October 3 so our designer can apply the template and check fonts. The moderator will collect three backup questions from each presenter in case the audience Q&A starts slowly.

A recording link goes to all registrants afterward, so avoid mentioning dates as 'today' during the talk.

Events Team

questions.q: Why should presenters use the same equipment as on the day?
choices: Switching equipment caused past technical issues
questions.exKo: 작년 기술 문제의 절반이 리허설 후 장비 교체에서 발생했습니다.

questions.q: Why are backup questions collected?
choices: In case audience Q&A starts slowly
questions.exKo: 청중 질문이 더디게 올라올 경우를 대비한 예비 질문입니다.

questions.q: Why should presenters avoid saying 'today'?
choices: The recording will be watched later
questions.exKo: 녹화본이 이후에 시청되므로 시점 표현을 피하라는 것입니다.

passages.title: 임대료 인상 협상 답신 메일
passages.passage:
From: Nadia Brandt, Brandt Property Group
To: Owen Marsh, Marsh & Field Accounting
Subject: Re: Lease Renewal Terms — Suite 900

Dear Mr. Marsh,

Thank you for your counterproposal regarding the renewal of Suite 900. You are a valued ten-year tenant, and I want to find terms that work.

On the base rent, the proposed 9 percent increase reflects two years of building upgrades, but I can reduce it to 6 percent for a five-year term, or 7.5 percent for three years. On the service charge, I cannot move on the rate itself; however, I will cap annual service charge increases at 3 percent for the full term, which addresses the unpredictability you raised.

I can also include the two storage units you currently rent separately at no additional cost — a saving of roughly $4,100 a year.

If these terms are acceptable, my office will send the revised lease within a week. I am available Thursday if you would like to discuss by phone.

Regards,
Nadia Brandt

questions.q: What does Ms. Brandt offer for a five-year term?
choices: A 6 percent rent increase instead of 9
questions.exKo: 5년 계약 시 인상률을 9%에서 6%로 낮춰 주겠다고 제안합니다.

questions.q: How does she address the service charge concern?
questions.exKo: 요율 자체는 못 바꾸지만 연간 인상률을 3%로 제한하기로 합니다.

questions.q: What extra concession is included?
choices: Two storage units at no cost
questions.exKo: 별도로 빌리던 창고 2개를 무상 포함해 연 4,100달러를 아껴 줍니다.

passages.title: 사내 방송 스튜디오 개방 공지
passages.passage:
CONTENT STUDIO — NOW BOOKABLE BY ALL TEAMS

The recording studio on floor 3, previously reserved for the marketing department, is now open to all teams for work-related recordings: training videos, customer webinars, podcast episodes, and internal announcements.

The studio includes two cameras, professional lighting, microphones, and a sound-treated booth. A staff technician is present Tuesday through Thursday and will handle equipment for you; on Mondays and Fridays, the studio is self-service and requires completion of a 30-minute orientation, offered twice monthly.

Book through the room system under 'Studio-3F' in blocks of up to two hours. Raw footage is saved to your team drive within one day; simple editing can be requested from the media team at three days' notice per finished video minute... please plan accordingly for long projects.

Media Services

questions.q: What changed about the studio?
choices: All teams may now book it
questions.exKo: 마케팅 전용이던 스튜디오가 전 부서에 개방되었습니다.

questions.q: What is required for self-service days?
questions.exKo: 월·금 셀프 이용은 30분 오리엔테이션 이수가 필요합니다.

questions.q: When is a technician available?
questions.exKo: 화~목요일에는 기사가 상주하며 장비를 조작해 줍니다.

passages.title: 품질 인증 심사 준비 공지
passages.passage:
ISO CERTIFICATION AUDIT — NOVEMBER 12-14

External auditors will visit November 12-14 to renew our quality management certification, which several major customers require in their contracts. Auditors will tour production, review records, and interview randomly selected employees about everyday procedures.

No special performance is expected — auditors want to see normal work done the normal way. However, please ensure before November 10 that: work instructions at your station match the current version on the document system, calibration stickers on measuring tools are unexpired, and training records for any new tasks are signed.

If an auditor asks a question you cannot answer, saying 'I would check the procedure, here is where I find it' is a correct answer — guessing is not. Department heads will run 20-minute refreshers next week.

Last renewal, auditors highlighted our corrective action tracking as best practice. Let's earn that again.

Quality Management

questions.q: Why does the certification matter?
choices: Major customers require it in contracts
questions.exKo: 주요 고객사들이 계약 조건으로 요구하는 인증입니다.

questions.q: What is the correct response to an unknown question?
choices: Saying where you would find the procedure
questions.exKo: 추측하지 말고 절차를 어디서 확인하는지 답하는 것이 정답입니다.

questions.q: What was praised at the last renewal?
questions.exKo: 시정 조치 추적 관리가 모범 사례로 꼽혔습니다.

passages.title: 온라인 계약 서명 플랫폼 광고
passages.passage:
INKFLOW — CONTRACTS SIGNED, NOT STUCK

Deals die waiting for signatures. InkFlow gets contracts signed 80 percent faster than paper, with legally binding e-signatures accepted in over 60 countries.

Send documents from your browser or CRM; signers click a link — no account needed — and sign from any device. Automatic reminders nudge the unresponsive, sequential signing routes documents in the right order, and the audit trail records every view and signature with a timestamp.

Templates turn repeat contracts into two-minute tasks, and fields auto-fill from your customer records. Bank-level encryption protects every document, with storage compliant with major data regulations.

Free for up to five documents monthly; business plans from $25 per user. Integrations with all major CRM and storage platforms included on every tier. Close faster at inkflow.app.

questions.q: What do signers need to sign a document?
questions.exKo: 계정 없이 링크만 열면 어느 기기에서나 서명할 수 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the audit trail record?
choices: Every view and signature with timestamps
questions.exKo: 모든 열람과 서명이 타임스탬프와 함께 기록됩니다.

questions.q: What is included on every plan tier?
questions.exKo: 주요 CRM·스토리지 연동은 모든 요금제에 포함됩니다.

passages.title: 공장 견학형 브랜드 팝업 광고
passages.passage:
SEE IT MADE — THE GLASSWORKS OPEN FACTORY

For three weekends only, Meridian Glassworks opens its doors to the public. Watch artisans shape molten glass into the tableware sold in our stores — then take a piece home at factory prices, up to 40 percent below retail.

Tours run hourly from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., last 45 minutes, and end in the factory shop. Children eight and older are welcome with adults; safety glasses are provided and closed shoes are required. The 2 p.m. tours include a hands-on session where visitors press their own glass coaster to keep — these slots book out fastest.

Tickets are $12 online, $15 at the gate, free for factory outlet members. Every ticket includes a $10 shop voucher. Book at meridianglass.com/openfactory.

questions.q: What is special about the 2 p.m. tours?
choices: Visitors press their own glass coaster
questions.exKo: 2시 투어에는 유리 컵받침을 직접 만들어 가져가는 체험이 포함됩니다.

questions.q: What is required to join a tour?
choices: A reservation only at the gate
questions.exKo: 보안경은 제공되며 발이 덮이는 신발은 필수입니다.

questions.q: What does every ticket include?
questions.exKo: 모든 티켓에 10달러 상당의 매장 바우처가 포함됩니다.

passages.title: 통근 패턴 변화와 상권 기사
passages.passage:
URBAN ECONOMY — Tuesday through Thursday has become the new rush hour week, transit data across five major cities show, with midweek ridership at 85 percent of pre-remote-work levels while Mondays and Fridays hover near 60 percent.

The shift is reshaping downtown businesses. Lunch spots report Tuesday-Wednesday queues but have cut Friday staffing by a third; several gyms moved group classes online on Mondays; and office-district hotels now market Thursday-to-Sunday leisure packages to fill rooms left empty by vanishing Friday business travel.

Commercial landlords respond too: leases increasingly include 'activity clauses' with rent partly tied to badge-swipe counts, and some buildings lease Monday-Friday space to different tenants — a design firm weekdays, a weekend pop-up school on Saturdays.

Economists note the pattern has stabilized: "Three-day physical weeks are not a transition — they are the destination," one report concludes.

questions.q: What does transit data show?
choices: Midweek ridership far exceeds Mondays and Fridays
questions.exKo: 화~목 이용률은 85%인 반면 월·금은 60% 수준입니다.

questions.q: How have hotels responded?
questions.exKo: 사라진 금요일 출장 수요를 목~일 여가 패키지로 메우고 있습니다.

questions.q: What are 'activity clauses' in leases?
choices: Rent partly tied to badge-swipe counts
questions.exKo: 출입 기록 수에 임대료 일부를 연동하는 조항입니다.

passages.title: 폐기 예정 식품 할인 앱 기사
passages.passage:
RETAIL INNOVATION — Supermarket chain Vartel has cut food waste 35 percent in pilot stores using an app that discounts items as their sell-by dates approach. Prices drop automatically — 30 percent three days before the date, 50 percent the day before — and shoppers see a live map of discounted shelves.

The chain feared the app would simply shift full-price sales to discounted ones, but basket analysis showed otherwise: discount hunters buy full-price items too, and 40 percent of app users were new or lapsed customers. Evening foot traffic, historically the quietest period, rose 12 percent.

Staff time once spent applying discount stickers — up to two hours daily per store — now goes to restocking. Vartel rolls the system out chain-wide in the spring and is negotiating to donate items unsold at closing to food charities, completing what its sustainability chief calls "a zero-waste sales floor."

questions.q: How does the app reduce waste?
choices: Automatically discounting items near sell-by dates
questions.exKo: 유통기한 임박 상품 가격을 자동으로 내려 판매합니다.

questions.q: What did basket analysis reveal?
choices: Discount shoppers also buy full-price items
questions.exKo: 할인 고객도 정가 상품을 함께 사고, 이용자의 40%는 신규·복귀 고객이었습니다.

questions.q: What happened to sticker-application time?
questions.exKo: 하루 최대 2시간 걸리던 스티커 작업 시간이 재고 보충에 쓰입니다.

passages.title: 신입 온보딩 첫 주 점검 문자
passages.passage:
Hana Cho (4:50 P.M.)
First week check — how are our two new analysts settling in?

Rob Vance (4:53 P.M.)
Mina's flying. Finished the data training early and already shadowing client calls.

Hana Cho (4:54 P.M.)
And Tomas?

Rob Vance (4:56 P.M.)
Struggling a bit with the reporting tool — his last company used something very different. He's quiet about it, but his practice exercises took twice the usual time.

Hana Cho (4:58 P.M.)
Let's get ahead of that. Can Mina pair with him on Monday's exercises? Peer help lands softer than a manager hovering.

Rob Vance (5:00 P.M.)
Good idea. I'll also swap his Thursday session for the advanced tool workshop — the intro one clearly isn't the gap.

Hana Cho (5:01 P.M.)
Agreed. And tell him directly that the first month is for learning, not proving. I'd rather he ask ten questions than hide one problem.

Rob Vance (5:02 P.M.)
Will do at tomorrow's check-in.

questions.q: What is Tomas's difficulty?
choices: The reporting tool differs from his old company's
questions.exKo: 이전 회사와 전혀 다른 리포팅 도구에 적응하지 못하고 있습니다.

questions.q: Why does Ms. Cho suggest pairing with Mina?
choices: Peer help feels less pressuring than manager oversight
questions.exKo: 동료의 도움이 관리자 감독보다 부담이 적기 때문입니다.

questions.q: What message should Tomas receive?
choices: The first month is for learning, not proving
questions.exKo: 첫 달은 증명이 아니라 배움의 기간이니 질문을 숨기지 말라는 것입니다.

passages.title: 전시 샘플 세관 서류 문자
passages.passage:
Igor Petrov (11:20 A.M.)
The demo units for the Singapore expo — regular export or ATA carnet?

Lena Fischer (11:24 A.M.)
Carnet. They come back after the show, so the carnet avoids paying import duties twice.

Igor Petrov (11:26 A.M.)
Right. The carnet lists 12 units — but sales wants to leave 2 units with a distributor there as samples.

Lena Fischer (11:29 A.M.)
Then those 2 can't travel on the carnet — everything listed must return or we pay penalties. Ship the distributor samples separately as a normal export with duties paid.

Igor Petrov (11:31 A.M.)
Got it. 10 on the carnet, 2 as regular export. Deadline for the carnet application?

Lena Fischer (11:33 A.M.)
Chamber of commerce needs 5 business days, and the show ships in 3 weeks — apply by Friday to be safe. Send me the final unit list with serial numbers today.

Igor Petrov (11:34 A.M.)
List coming within the hour.

questions.q: Why use an ATA carnet for the demo units?
choices: It avoids paying import duties on returning goods
It is faster than air freight
questions.exKo: 전시 후 돌아올 물품이라 이중 관세를 피할 수 있기 때문입니다.

questions.q: Why can't the two distributor samples go on the carnet?
choices: Carnet items must all return or penalties apply
questions.exKo: 카르네에 오른 물품은 전량 반입되어야 하며 아니면 벌금이 부과됩니다.

questions.q: What must Mr. Petrov send today?
choices: The final unit list with serial numbers
questions.exKo: 일련번호가 포함된 최종 물품 목록을 오늘 보내야 합니다.
